additional_info.subject: ID0478383-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R6 170002262] Charging session interruption CRM:03056001022
additional_info.body:
Hi Szymon,
I checked this charger since 1st Jan there is only 2 instances of CableTempSensor.
It is indeed true because the difference between DC+ and DC- value is >25ºC which is our borderline limit to session stop.
From my point of view, since it only occurred 2 times now, it's starting to indicate that a real problem is here, but I would like to have at least 1 more month of occurrences to proof that it's not an isolated issue with a certain EV.
What do you think? I can either close this ticket and you reopen when you have more instances in 1 month time, or I can send to RC_PL for monitoring.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
